children: BTIG is still bullish on Booking Holdings

ahead of the third-quarter earnings season. The firm maintained a Buy given the online travel giant's industry leadership, above-category growth, and attractive financial profile that includes a strong balance sheet, category-leading margin, and free cash flow conversion.
Analyst Jake Fuller noted that valuation on Booking Holdings

is modest and the company has emerged as a high-quality earnings compounder. Notably, Fuller and his team argued that fears over the emergence of AI agents may be overdone. "We argue agents will point travelers towards the OTAs to access the breadth of lodging supply, see real-time pricing, access the best room rates, and leverage fulfillment infrastructure," he highlighted.
BTIG's price target of $250 is based on a 2027 PE of 20X, which is the midpoint of the historical multiple range.
The all-time closing high for the stock closing price was $230.13 on July 7, 2025.

title: BTIG thinks AI agent fears with Booking Holdings are overdone
